newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cert coffee stocks up 2,000 bags in Dec 6 wk.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cert coffee stocks up 2,000 bags in Dec 6 wk.

text.p: U.S. certified coffee stocks rose by 2,000 60-kg bags in the week ended December 6, to 2,231 bags, posting their first substantial increase in months, the Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange reported on Monday.

In addition, 5,500 bags of Guatemalan coffee were certified for delivery in Miami between December 6-9, after the close of weekly reporting period, bringing the total certified inventory to 7,821 bags. An additional 11,750 bags were reported pending grading at Miami.
